The file `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` contains all memo CRUD mutations and queries — `useCreateMemo`, `useUpdateMemo`, `useDeleteMemo`, `useMemo`, `useMemos`, `useInfiniteMemos`, etc. It imports `memoServiceClient` from `@/connect` (`web/src/connect.ts:197`), which is created via `createClient(MemoService, transport)` — a generated Connect-RPC client for the `MemoService`.
